districtFact: Salem-Keizer Public Schools, Oregon School District 24J, publishes a family key-date calendar with grade-specific first days, a separate kindergarten transition, middle-school trimester markers, a high-school semester marker, and different last days for grades K-5 and 6-11. The 2026-2027 family calendar is available in English plus Arabic, Chuukese, Russian, Spanish, and Swahili.

about.title: About the Salem-Keizer Family Calendar
about.content: The SKPS family key-date calendar is a districtwide planning document, not a complete list of every school event. It identifies first days by grade, kindergarten transition, student-free days, conferences, breaks, grading and staff-development dates, graduation dates, and grade-level last days. Individual schools may publish additional dates.

about.title: The School Year Does Not Have One First Day
about.content: Grades 6 and 9 begin first, followed one day later by grades 1-5, 7-8, and 10-12. Kindergarten then uses two transition dates before all kindergarten students begin together. Families should use the date for each child rather than treating the earliest opening as a districtwide first day.

about.title: Middle and High Schools Use Different Academic Markers
about.content: The family calendar identifies trimester starts for middle schools and a semester start for high schools. These dates are not interchangeable: middle-school trimester two begins in December and trimester three begins after Spring Break, while high-school semester two begins in February.

about.title: June Ends Differently by Grade Level
about.content: High school graduations are scheduled June 9-11, grades K-5 finish June 16, and grades 6-11 finish June 17. The calendar also warns that days may be added in June after emergency closures but does not preassign specific make-up dates.

about.title: Six Family Calendar Language Editions
about.content: SKPS publishes the 2026-2027 family key-date calendar in English, Arabic, Chuukese, Russian, Spanish, and Swahili. These are translations of the same family calendar; separate staff calendars are published elsewhere on the district calendar page.

planningTips.title: Salem-Keizer Public Schools Calendar Notes
content: Match the first day to the student's grade: grades 6 and 9 begin September 8, most other grades begin September 9, and all kindergarten students begin September 16.
Use the kindergarten transition schedule provided by the school for September 14-15; the district key-date calendar does not describe one universal attendance pattern for those two days.
Plan for the October 28-30 closure as three consecutive student-free weekdays: two fall-conference days followed by a separate no-school day.
Treat November 30 as a student-free day. The live calendar calls it a grading day, while the family PDF labels it Professional Development/District Directed.
Middle-school trimester dates and the high-school semester date apply to different grade levels.
Expect different June ending dates for elementary and secondary students, and do not assume graduation dates are the last attendance dates for every high school student.
Keep June plans flexible after an emergency closure because SKPS may add instructional days without listing reserved dates in advance.
Use the official calendar page and school messages for revisions after importing the one-time MySchoolDates ICS file.

districtFaqs.q: When does Salem-Keizer Public Schools start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: Grades 6 and 9 begin Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 begin September 9. Kindergarten has transition dates September 14–15, and all kindergarten students begin September 16.

districtFaqs.q: When does Salem-Keizer kindergarten start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: SKPS lists kindergarten transition on September 14–15 and the first day for all kindergarten students on September 16. Families should follow the transition schedule sent by their school.

districtFaqs.q: When is Salem-Keizer Spring Break in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027. Students are also out March 17 for grading and staff development, March 18 for spring conferences, and March 19 for a separate no-school day.

districtFaqs.q: When is the last day of Salem-Keizer Public Schools in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: Grades K–5 finish Wednesday, June 16, 2027. Grades 6–11 finish Thursday, June 17. The district notes that June days may be added after emergency closures.

districtFaqs.q: Does Salem-Keizer publish translated school calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The 2026-2027 family key-date calendar is available in English, Arabic, Chuukese, Russian, Spanish, and Swahili.

districtFaqs.q: Are Salem-Keizer emergency make-up dates already scheduled?
districtFaqs.a: No specific dates are reserved on the family calendar. SKPS says days may be added in June after emergency closures, so families should wait for a district announcement before treating any additional June date as a school day.
